IDS_ENABLE_DEBUGGING_HELP.en:
BEGIN_H3Debugging FeaturesEND_H3
          BR
          You can enable the debugging features on your NickelOS device in order to install and test custom code on your device.  This will allow you to:BR
          BEGIN_LIST
            LIST_ITEMRemove rootfs verification so you can modify OS files
            LIST_ITEMEnable SSH access to the device using the standard test keys so you can use tools such as BEGIN_CODE'cros flash'END_CODE to access the device
            LIST_ITEMEnable booting from USB so you can install an OS image from a USB drive
            LIST_ITEMSet both the dev and the system root login password to a custom value so you can manually SSH into the device
          END_LIST
          BR
          Once enabled, most of the debugging features will remain enabled even after performing a powerwash or wiping the data on an enterprise managed device.  To fully disable all debugging features, reinstall NickelOS.
          BR
          BR
          For more information about the debugging features see:BR
          https://www.chromium.org/chromium-os/how-tos-and-troubleshooting/debugging-features
          BR
          BR
          BEGIN_BOLDNote:END_BOLD  The system will reboot during the process.
IDS_ENABLE_DEBUGGING_HELP.t:
BEGIN_H3Funkcije za otklanjanje grešakaEND_H3
          BR
          Možete da omogućite funkcije za otklanjanje grešaka na NickelOS uređaju da biste instalirali i testirali prilagođeni kôd na uređaju. To će vam omogućiti:BR
          BEGIN_LIST
            LIST_ITEMDa uklonite rootfs verifikaciju da biste mogli da menjate fajlove operativnog sistema
            LIST_ITEMDa omogućite SSH pristup uređaju pomoću standardnih probnih ključeva da biste mogli da koristite alatke kao što je BEGIN_CODEcros flashEND_CODE radi pristupa uređaju
            LIST_ITEMDa omogućite uključivanje sa USB-a da biste mogli da instalirate sliku operativnog sistema sa USB diska
            LIST_ITEMDa podešavate i programersku i sistemsku osnovnu lozinku za prijavljivanje na prilagođenu vrednost da biste mogli ručno da pristupite uređaju preko SSH-a
          END_LIST
          BR
          Kada ih omogućite, većina funkcija za otklanjanje grešaka će ostati omogućena čak i kada izvršite powerwash ili obrišete podatke na uređaju kojim upravlja preduzeće. Da biste u potpunosti onemogućili sve funkcije za otklanjanje grešaka, ponovo instalirajte NickelOS.
          BR
          BR
          Više informacija o funkcijama za otklanjanje grešaka potražite na:BR
          https://www.chromium.org/chromium-os/how-tos-and-troubleshooting/debugging-features
          BR
          BR
          BEGIN_BOLDNapomenaEND_BOLD: Sistem će se restartovati tokom ovog procesa.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_HINT.t: Da biste promenili prečicu, izaberite njene tastere i pritisnite nove. Taster Backspace uklanja prečicu.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants these shortcuts to work while you use other apps too. It learns only when you press them, not what else you type.
IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME želi da ove prečice rade i dok koristite druge aplikacije. Saznaće samo kada ih pritisnete, a ne šta još unosite.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_NEEDS_MODIFI.en: Use Ctrl, Alt or Search with the key, or a function key.
IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_NEEDS_MODIFI.t: Koristite Ctrl, Alt ili taster za pretragu zajedno sa tasterom ili koristite funkcijski taster.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_TAKEN.en: Those keys are already in use. Try others.
IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_TAKEN.t: Ti tasteri se već koriste. Probajte druge.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_TITLE.t: Želite li da dozvolite tasterske prečice?

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_FAILED_DE.en: Could not create the account: DETAIL.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_SIGN_IN.en: Could not set up the account: DETAIL

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_TOO_LONG.en: Creating the account took too long. Try again.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_TOO_LONG.t: Pravljenje naloga je trajalo predugo. Probajte ponovo.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_USERNAME.en: Usernames start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32).
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_USERNAME.t: Korisnička imena počinju malim slovom i sadrže samo mala slova, cifre, - i _ (najviše 32).

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_PICTURE_SUBTITL.en: It shows on the sign-in screen and in the system tray. To use a photo of your own, go to Settings later.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_PICTURE_SUBTITL.t: Prikazuje se na ekranu za prijavljivanje i na sistemskoj traci. Ako želite da koristite svoju fotografiju, kasnije otvorite Podešavanja.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_SUBTITLE.en: Your account and its files live on this device, encrypted with your password. Without a Google account there is no way to recover them if you forget it.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_SUBTITLE.t: Nalog i njegovi fajlovi se čuvaju na ovom uređaju, šifrovani vašom lozinkom. Bez Google naloga ne možete da ih vratite ako zaboravite lozinku.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_USERNAME_ERROR.en: Start with a lowercase letter; use lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32)
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_USERNAME_ERROR.t: Počnite malim slovom; koristite mala slova, cifre, - i _ (najviše 32)

IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to know where this device is, found from nearby Wi-Fi networks and its internet address. Your answer is remembered for this app.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME želi da zna gde se ovaj uređaj nalazi, na osnovu obližnjih WiFi mreža i njegove internet adrese. Vaš odgovor se pamti za ovu aplikaciju.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_TITLE.en: Allow APP_NAME to use your location?
IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_TITLE.t: Želite li da dozvolite da APP_NAME koristi vašu lokaciju?

IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_OFF_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to use your location. To let it, turn on location access in Privacy controls.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_OFF_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME želi da koristi vašu lokaciju. Da biste to dozvolili, uključite pristup lokaciji u kontrolama privatnosti.

IDS_NICKEL_REMOTE_CONTROL_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to control this device's keyboard and pointer. Allow it only if you trust whoever is connecting.
IDS_NICKEL_REMOTE_CONTROL_MESSAGE.t: APP_NAME želi da upravlja tastaturom i pokazivačem ovog uređaja. Dozvolite to samo ako imate poverenja u osobu koja se povezuje.

IDS_NICKEL_REMOTE_CONTROL_TITLE.t: Želite li da dozvolite daljinsko upravljanje?

IDS_NICKEL_SEARCH_ENGINE_CHOICE_INFO_DIA.en: You chose Minimal when you set up NickelOS, so no search engine was picked for you. These search engines are popular in your region and are shown in random order.
IDS_NICKEL_SEARCH_ENGINE_CHOICE_INFO_DIA.t: Kada ste podešavali NickelOS, izabrali ste opciju „Minimalno“, pa vam nije podešen nijedan pretraživač. Ovi pretraživači su popularni u vašem regionu i prikazuju se nasumičnim redosledom.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_EITHER_WAY.en: Either way, you get Bazaar to find more apps, and apps to open your photos, videos, music and documents.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_EITHER_WAY.t: U oba slučaja dobijate Bazaar za pronalaženje novih aplikacija, kao i aplikacije za otvaranje slika, video snimaka, muzike i dokumenata.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_FULL_DESCRIPTION.en: Everything ready to go, and private. DuckDuckGo searches the web from the browser and the launcher, uBlock Origin blocks ads and trackers in the browser, Proton's private apps (Mail, Calendar, Drive, Pass and more) are installed, and free, open-source apps come with it: LibreOffice, OBS Studio, GIMP, Kdenlive and more.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_FULL_DESCRIPTION.t: Sve je spremno za rad, uz punu privatnost. DuckDuckGo pretražuje veb iz pregledača i Pokretača, uBlock Origin blokira oglase i elemente za praćenje u pregledaču, instalirane su privatne aplikacije kompanije Proton (Mail, Calendar, Drive, Pass i druge), a dobijate i besplatne aplikacije otvorenog koda: LibreOffice, OBS Studio, GIMP, Kdenlive i druge.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_MINIMAL_DESCRIPTION.en: Just the basics. The launcher searches only this computer, and nothing else is set up for you.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_MINIMAL_DESCRIPTION.t: Samo osnovno. Pokretač pretražuje samo ovaj računar i ništa drugo se ne podešava umesto vas.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_SUBTITLE.en: You can change all of this later in Settings.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_SUBTITLE.t: Sve ovo možete kasnije da promenite u Podešavanjima.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_TITLE.en: How would you like to start?

IDS_OMNIBOX_PEDAL_MANAGE_CHROMEOS_ACCESS.en: Personalize your accessibility tools in NickelOS settings
IDS_OMNIBOX_PEDAL_MANAGE_CHROMEOS_ACCESS.t: Personalizujte alatke za pristupačnost u podešavanjima NickelOS-a

IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.en: Do you want to activate ChromeVox, the built-in screen reader for NickelOS? If so, press the space bar.
IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.t: Želite li da aktivirate ChromeVox, ugrađeni čitač ekrana za NickelOS? Ako je tako, pritisnite taster za razmak.

IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.en: Do you want to activate ChromeVox, the built-in screen reader for NickelOS? If so, press and hold both volume keys for five seconds.
IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.t: Želite li da aktivirate ChromeVox, ugrađeni čitač ekrana za NickelOS? Ako je tako, pritisnite i zadržite oba tastera za jačinu zvuka pet sekundi.

IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_TEXT.en: Do you want to activate ChromeVox, the built-in screen reader for NickelOS?
IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_TEXT.t: Želite li da aktivirate ChromeVox, ugrađeni čitač ekrana za NickelOS?

IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_CONTENT_0.en: Before starting, make sure you have a backup of your data. Installing DEVICE_OS will overwrite the disk you choose.
IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_CONTENT_0.t: Pre nego što počnete, uverite se da ste napravili rezervnu kopiju podataka. Instaliranjem sistema DEVICE_OS zameniće se podaci na disku koji izaberete.

IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_FOOTER.en: DEVICE_OS is free software provided as is: it may not work on every computer, and its authors are not responsible for any data loss.
IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_FOOTER.t: DEVICE_OS je slobodan softver koji se pruža „takav kakav jeste“: možda neće raditi na svakom računaru, a njegovi autori nisu odgovorni ni za kakav gubitak podataka.

IDS_OS_SETTINGS_SANITIZE_FEEDBACK.en: Help make NickelOS better by reporting the BEGIN_LINKcurrent settingsEND_LINK
IDS_OS_SETTINGS_SANITIZE_FEEDBACK.t: Pomozite da poboljšamo NickelOS tako što ćete poslati izveštaj o BEGIN_LINKaktuelnim podešavanjimaEND_LINK

IDS_OS_SETTINGS_SYNC_FEATURE_LABEL.en: Your apps and settings will sync across all NickelOS devices where you are signed in with your Google account. For browser sync options, go to LINK_BEGINChrome settingsLINK_END.
IDS_OS_SETTINGS_SYNC_FEATURE_LABEL.t: Aplikacije i podešavanja će se sinhronizovati na svim NickelOS uređajima na kojima ste prijavljeni pomoću svog Google naloga. Opcije sinhronizacije pregledača pronađite u LINK_BEGINpodešavanjima Chrome-aLINK_END.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: When your screen is idle, show your pictures, time, and media info
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Kada je ekran neaktivan, prikazuju se vaše slike, vreme i informacije o medijskom sadržaju

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: The screen saver shows the pictures in your Pictures folder and the folders in it. Add at least 2.
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Čuvar ekrana prikazuje slike iz foldera Slike i foldera u njemu. Dodajte bar 2 slike.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: The screen saver shows NickelOS's wallpapers. Turn this on to show the pictures in My files > Pictures instead.
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Čuvar ekrana prikazuje pozadine sistema NickelOS. Uključite ovo da biste umesto njih prikazivali slike iz foldera Moje datoteke > Pictures.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: From Open-Meteo, for your approximate location, which beaconDB works out from your internet address
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Od usluge Open-Meteo, za vašu približnu lokaciju, koju beaconDB određuje na osnovu vaše IP adrese

IDS_PRINT_PREVIEW_PRINTER_SETUP_INFO_MES.en: Make sure your printer is turned on and connected to the same network as your NickelOS device or use a USB cable
IDS_PRINT_PREVIEW_PRINTER_SETUP_INFO_MES.t: Uverite se da je štampač uključen i povezan na istu mrežu kao i NickelOS uređaj ili koristite USB kabl

IDS_RELAUNCH_TO_UPDATE.t: Ponovo pokreni da bi se &NickelOS ažurirao

IDS_SETTINGS_ACCOUNT_BODY_CHROMEOS.en: When on, data is saved in your Google Account and can be used on all your devices. When off, data is saved only to this device. For NickelOS sync options, go to LINK_BEGINNickelOS settingsLINK_END.
IDS_SETTINGS_ACCOUNT_BODY_CHROMEOS.t: Kada je uključeno, podaci se čuvaju na Google nalogu i mogu da se koriste na svim uređajima. Kada je isključeno, podaci se čuvaju samo na ovom uređaju. Opcije sinhronizovanja NickelOS-a potražite u LINK_BEGINpodešavanjima NickelOS-aLINK_END.

IDS_SETTINGS_APPS_ARC_VM_SHARED_USB_DEVI.en: Give Android apps control over USB devices on this NickelOS device. Permission will be requested each time you plug in a USB device. Individual Android apps will ask for additional permissions.
IDS_SETTINGS_APPS_ARC_VM_SHARED_USB_DEVI.t: Omogućite Android aplikacijama da kontrolišu USB uređaje na ovom NickelOS uređaju. One će tražiti dozvolu svaki put kada uključite USB uređaj. Pojedinačne Android aplikacije će tražiti dodatne dozvole.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.en: Your device is no longer receiving security and software updates.
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.t: Uređaj više ne prima bezbednosna i softverska ažuriranja.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.en: This device no longer gets updates
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.t: Ovaj uređaj više ne dobija ažuriranja

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.en: Your device is no longer receiving security and software updates.
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.t: Uređaj više ne prima bezbednosna i softverska ažuriranja.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.en: This device no longer gets updates
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.t: Ovaj uređaj više ne dobija ažuriranja

IDS_SETTINGS_GUEST_OS_SHARED_USB_DEVICES.en: Give Android apps control over USB devices on this NickelOS device
IDS_SETTINGS_GUEST_OS_SHARED_USB_DEVICES.t: Omogućite Android aplikacijama da kontrolišu USB uređaje na ovom NickelOS uređaju

IDS_SETTINGS_NEARBY_SHARE_DATA_USAGE_MOB.en: This option applies to NickelOS devices with a data plan or mobile network dongle, or when tethering to a portable hotspot
IDS_SETTINGS_NEARBY_SHARE_DATA_USAGE_MOB.t: Ova opcija važi za NickelOS uređaje sa donglom za tarifni paket ili mobilnu mrežu, odnosno pri privezivanju na prenosivi hotspot

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADD_PERSON_.en: You'll be signed out. On the sign-in screen, the new person chooses a name, a username and a password.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADD_PERSON_.t: Bićete odjavljeni. Na ekranu za prijavljivanje nova osoba bira ime, korisničko ime i lozinku.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADMIN_BODY.en: Administrators can install software for everyone, change the system and manage accounts.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADMIN_BODY.t: Administratori mogu da instaliraju softver za sve, menjaju sistem i upravljaju nalozima.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_FAILED.t: Došlo je do greške. Probajte ponovo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_LAST_ADMIN.en: This device needs at least one administrator
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_LAST_ADMIN.t: Ovom uređaju je potreban bar jedan administrator

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_MAKE_ADMIN_.t: Želite li da NAME postane administrator?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_NO_OTHER_PE.en: No one else has an account on this device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_NO_OTHER_PE.t: Niko drugi nema nalog na ovom uređaju.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_OTHER_PEOPL.en: Everyone has their own account and files. Administrators can install software for everyone, change the system and manage accounts.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_OTHER_PEOPL.t: Svako ima svoj nalog i svoje fajlove. Administratori mogu da instaliraju softver za sve, menjaju sistem i upravljaju nalozima.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_ADMI.t: Želite li da NAME postane standardni korisnik?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_BODY.en: Their account and all their files are deleted from this device. This can't be undone.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_BODY.t: Nalog te osobe i svi njeni fajlovi se brišu sa ovog uređaja. Ovo ne može da se opozove.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_TITL.t: Želite li da uklonite korisnika NAME?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ADMIN_ONLY.en: Only an administrator of this device can change these.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ADMIN_ONLY.t: Samo administrator ovog uređaja može da menja ova podešavanja.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DESCRIPT.en: For apps built only for the ARM processors phones use, many games among them. Proprietary software, downloaded when you turn it on.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DESCRIPT.t: Za aplikacije napravljene samo za ARM procesore kakve koriste telefoni, među kojima su i mnoge igre. Vlasnički softver, preuzima se kada ga uključite.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.en: Many Android apps, games especially, are built only for the ARM processors phones use. To run them on this computer, Android needs a translator. NickelOS doesn't make or include one: turning this on downloads TRANSLATOR from GitHub, the same copy the Waydroid community's waydroid_script installs.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.t: Mnoge Android aplikacije, naročito igre, napravljene su samo za ARM procesore kakve koriste telefoni. Da bi ih pokrenuo na ovom računaru, Android-u je potreban prevodilac. NickelOS ga ne pravi niti uključuje: kada ovo uključite, sa GitHub-a se preuzima TRANSLATOR, ista kopija koju instalira waydroid_script zajednice Waydroid.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.en: It's proprietary software, under its owner's terms, and you're the one installing it. Some apps may run slowly or not at all. Android restarts to use it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.t: To je vlasnički softver, podleže uslovima svog vlasnika, a vi ste ti koji ga instalirate. Neke aplikacije će možda raditi sporo ili uopšte neće raditi. Android se ponovo pokreće da bi počeo da ga koristi.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_T.t: Želite li da uključite podršku za ARM aplikacije?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_DOWNLO.en: The download didn't finish. Check your connection, then try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_DOWNLO.t: Preuzimanje nije dovršeno. Proverite vezu, pa probajte ponovo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_FAILED.t: Došlo je do greške. Probajte ponovo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DESCR.en: Deletes Android, your Android apps and their data
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DESCR.t: Briše Android, vaše Android aplikacije i njihove podatke

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DIALO.en: Android, your Android apps and their data are deleted from this device. Other people who use it keep their Android data, but can't open their Android apps until Android is set up again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DIALO.t: Android, vaše Android aplikacije i njihovi podaci se brišu sa ovog uređaja. Drugi korisnici ovog uređaja zadržavaju svoje Android podatke, ali ne mogu da otvaraju Android aplikacije dok se Android ponovo ne podesi.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_SET_UP_DESCR.en: Android apps open in their own windows, next to your other apps. Setting up downloads Android (LineageOS, from the Waydroid project): about 1 GB, and 2.5 GB on this device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_SET_UP_DESCR.t: Android aplikacije se otvaraju u zasebnim prozorima, pored drugih aplikacija. Podešavanjem se preuzima Android (LineageOS, iz projekta Waydroid): oko 1 GB, a na ovom uređaju zauzima 2,5 GB.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_UNAVAILABLE.en: Android apps aren't available right now.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_USES.en: Android uses SIZE on this device
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_USES.t: Android zauzima SIZE na ovom uređaju

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DESCRIPTION.en: See Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and other cloud storage in Files
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DESCRIPTION.t: Pregledajte Google disk, OneDrive, Dropbox i druga skladišta u oblaku u aplikaciji Fajlovi

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DONE.t: ACCOUNT_NAME je sada u aplikaciji Fajlovi.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DRIVE_HELP.en: Google Drive needs your own client ID and secret from the Google Cloud console.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DRIVE_HELP.t: Za Google disk su potrebni vaš ID klijenta i tajni ključ iz Google Cloud konzole.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_FAILED.en: Couldn't connect. Check the details and try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_FAILED.t: Povezivanje nije uspelo. Proverite podatke i probajte ponovo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_RCLONE.en: NickelOS uses rclone to show your cloud storage in Files, so your files are easy to reach. Choose a service to sign in to.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_RCLONE.t: NickelOS koristi rclone da bi prikazao skladište u oblaku u aplikaciji Fajlovi, pa lako pristupate fajlovima. Izaberite uslugu na koju želite da se prijavite.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_REMOVE_BODY.en: Files stops showing this account. Your files stay in the cloud, and you can add the account again later.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_REMOVE_BODY.t: Aplikacija Fajlovi više neće prikazivati ovaj nalog. Fajlovi ostaju u oblaku, a nalog možete ponovo da dodate kasnije.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_REMOVE_TITLE.t: Želite li da uklonite nalog ACCOUNT_NAME?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGNING_IN.en: Finish signing in on the page that opened in your browser.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGNING_IN.t: Dovršite prijavljivanje na stranici koja se otvorila u pregledaču.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGN_IN_NOTE.en: When you connect, the service's sign-in page opens in your browser.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGN_IN_NOTE.t: Kada se povežete, u pregledaču će se otvoriti stranica za prijavljivanje na uslugu.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_TWO_FACTOR.t: Kôd za verifikaciju u 2 koraka (ako je koristite)

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_ADMIN_.en: Only an administrator of this computer can change its name.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_ADMIN_.t: Samo administrator ovog računara može da promeni njegov naziv.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_DIALOG.en: Other devices see this name on your network and over Bluetooth, and the Terminal and Linux apps show it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_DIALOG.t: Drugi uređaji vide ovaj naziv na mreži i preko Bluetooth-a, a prikazuju ga i Terminal i Linux aplikacije.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_FAILED.en: The name couldn't be changed. Try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_FAILED.t: Promena naziva nije uspela. Probajte ponovo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_INVALI.en: Use at least one letter from A to Z or a number.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_INVALI.t: Koristite bar jedno slovo od A do Z ili broj.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_DESCRIP.en: The apps that open each kind of file, from Files and from Linux apps
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_DESCRIP.t: Aplikacije koje otvaraju svaku vrstu fajlova iz aplikacije Fajlovi i iz Linux aplikacija

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVES_DESCRIPTION.en: Drives inside this device besides the one with NickelOS. The drive that holds Windows opens read-only, so Windows stays intact.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVES_DESCRIPTION.t: Diskovi u ovom uređaju osim onog na kome je NickelOS. Disk na kome je Windows otvara se samo za čitanje, kako bi Windows ostao netaknut.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_ALLOW_CHANGES_.en: Windows is on this drive. It's read-only unless you allow changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_ALLOW_CHANGES_.t: Windows je na ovom disku. Disk je samo za čitanje ako ne dozvolite izmene.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_BODY.en: With Fast Startup, Windows doesn't fully shut down, and changes made here can be lost or damage files when Windows starts again. Turn off Fast Startup in Windows, or hold Shift while you shut Windows down, before you make changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_BODY.t: Kada je uključeno brzo pokretanje, Windows se ne isključuje potpuno, pa izmene koje ovde unesete mogu da se izgube ili da oštete fajlove kada se Windows ponovo pokrene. Pre unošenja izmena isključite brzo pokretanje u Windows-u ili držite Shift dok isključujete Windows.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_TITLE.en: Allow changes to the Windows drive?
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_TITLE.t: Želite li da dozvolite izmene na Windows disku?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_HIBERNATED.en: Windows didn't shut down fully, so the drive stays read-only. Shut down Windows fully to make changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_HIBERNATED.t: Windows nije potpuno isključen, pa disk ostaje samo za čitanje. Potpuno isključite Windows da biste unosili izmene.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_COMMUNITY_DESCR.en: The forum, Discord and GitHub, on nickelos.dev
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_COMMUNITY_DESCR.t: Forum, Discord i GitHub na sajtu nickelos.dev

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GENTOO_DESCRIPT.en: Portage and emerge from the start, with pacman and apt commands side by side
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GENTOO_DESCRIPT.t: Portage i emerge od početka, uz uporedne komande za pacman i apt

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GUIDE_DESCRIPTI.en: How NickelOS works. This copy came with your version of NickelOS and works offline.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GUIDE_DESCRIPTI.t: Kako funkcioniše NickelOS. Ova kopija je stigla uz vašu verziju sistema NickelOS i radi i oflajn.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_MENU_ITEM_DESCR.t: Vodič, učenje sistema Gentoo, rešavanje problema

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_TROUBLESHOOTING.en: Logs, crash reports, and the usual problems and their fixes
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_TROUBLESHOOTING.t: Evidencije, izveštaji o otkazivanju i uobičajeni problemi i njihova rešenja

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_DESCRIPTION.en: With the KDE Connect app on Android or iPhone, on the same Wi‑Fi network
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_DESCRIPTION.t: Pomoću aplikacije KDE Connect na Android-u ili iPhone-u, na istoj WiFi mreži

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NONE.en: No phones or tablets yet. Install KDE Connect from Google Play, F‑Droid or the App Store, open it on the same Wi‑Fi network, then pair from either device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NONE.t: Još nema telefona ni tableta. Instalirajte KDE Connect sa Google Play-a, F‑Droid-a ili App Store-a, otvorite ga na istoj WiFi mreži, pa pokrenite uparivanje sa bilo kog od dva uređaja.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NOT_RUNNING.en: The phone connection isn't running. Sign out and back in to start it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NOT_RUNNING.t: Veza sa telefonom nije pokrenuta. Odjavite se i ponovo se prijavite da biste je pokrenuli.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_WANTS_TO_PAIR.en: Wants to pair with this device
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_WANTS_TO_PAIR.t: Želi da se upari sa ovim uređajem

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_DESCRIPTION.en: Lets apps such as Discord use push-to-talk while you're in other windows. They see keys pressed with Ctrl, Alt or Search and function keys, never what you type.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_DESCRIPTION.t: Omogućava aplikacijama kao što je Discord da koriste funkciju „pritisni za razgovor“ dok ste u drugim prozorima. Te aplikacije vide tastere pritisnute uz Ctrl, Alt ili taster za pretragu i funkcijske tastere, ali nikada ono što unosite.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_LABEL.en: Shortcut keys for older Linux apps
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_LABEL.t: Tasterske prečice za starije Linux aplikacije

IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_HELP_SECTION_.en: Make sure your printer is connected to the same Wi-Fi network as your NickelOS device or use a USB cable. LINK_BEGINLearn more about compatibilityLINK_END
IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_HELP_SECTION_.t: Uverite se da je štampač povezan na istu WiFi mrežu kao i NickelOS uređaj ili koristite USB kabl. LINK_BEGINSaznajte više o kompatibilnostiLINK_END

IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_PRINTER_ADDED.en: Can’t connect to printer. Check that the printer is turned on and is connected to your NickelOS device by Wi-Fi or USB.
IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_PRINTER_ADDED.t: Povezivanje sa štampačem nije uspelo. Proverite da li je štampač uključen i povezan sa NickelOS uređajem pomoću WiFi-a ili USB-a.

IDS_SETTINGS_SECURE_DNS_OPEN_CHROME_OS_S.en: Manage secure DNS in NickelOS settings
IDS_SETTINGS_SECURE_DNS_OPEN_CHROME_OS_S.t: Upravljajte bezbednim DNS-om u podešavanjima NickelOS-a

IDS_SETTINGS_SWITCH_ACCESS_SETUP_INTRO_B.en: To get started, please make sure your USB or Bluetooth switch is connected to your NickelOS device. You can also use keyboard keys.
IDS_SETTINGS_SWITCH_ACCESS_SETUP_INTRO_B.t: Da biste započeli, proverite da li je USB ili Bluetooth prekidač povezan na NickelOS uređaj. Možete da koristite i tastere na tastaturi.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_LOOKING_FOR_PHONE.en: To unlock your NickelOS device, make sure your phone's Bluetooth is on
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_LOOKING_FOR_PHONE.t: Da biste otključali NickelOS uređaj, uverite se da je Bluetooth na telefonu uključen

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_BLUETOOTH.en: Your NickelOS device’s Bluetooth is off. To unlock your NickelOS device, enter password.
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_BLUETOOTH.t: Bluetooth na NickelOS uređaju je isključen. Da biste otključali NickelOS uređaj, unesite lozinku.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_PHONE_LOCK_SCREE.en: Your phone doesn’t have a lock screen. To unlock your NickelOS device, enter password.
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_PHONE_LOCK_SCREE.t: Telefon nema zaključani ekran. Da biste otključali NickelOS uređaj, unesite lozinku.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_PHONE_LOCKED.en: To unlock your NickelOS device, first unlock your phone
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_PHONE_LOCKED.t: Da biste otključali NickelOS uređaj, prvo otključajte telefon

IDS_SMART_PRIVACY_PROTECTION_CONTENT.en: Your device uses a built-in sensor to detect people in front of it. All data is processed on your device immediately and then deleted. Sensor data is never sent to Google.
IDS_SMART_PRIVACY_PROTECTION_CONTENT.t: Uređaj koristi ugrađeni senzor za otkrivanje ljudi koji se nalaze ispred njega. Svi podaci se odmah obrađuju na uređaju, a zatim brišu. Podaci senzora se nikada ne šalju Google-u.

IDS_SYNC_OTHER_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW.en: NickelOS could not sync your data due to an error signing in.
IDS_SYNC_OTHER_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW.t: NickelOS ne može da sinhronizuje podatke zbog greške pri prijavljivanju.

IDS_SYNC_OTHER_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW.en: NickelOS could not save Chromium data in your Google Account due to an error signing in
IDS_SYNC_OTHER_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW.t: NickelOS nije uspeo da sačuva Chromium podatke na Google nalogu zbog greške pri prijavljivanju

IDS_SYNC_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_MESSA.en: NickelOS could not sync your data because your account sign-in details are out of date.
IDS_SYNC_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_MESSA.t: NickelOS ne može da sinhronizuje podatke zato što su podaci za prijavljivanje na nalog zastareli.

IDS_SYNC_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_MESSA.en: NickelOS could not save Chromium data in your Google Account because your account sign-in details are out of date
IDS_SYNC_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_MESSA.t: NickelOS nije uspeo da sačuva Chromium podatke na Google nalogu zato što su podaci za prijavljivanje na nalog zastareli

IDS_SYNC_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_M.en: NickelOS could not sync your data because Sync is not available for your domain.
IDS_SYNC_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_M.t: NickelOS ne može da sinhronizuje podatke jer Sinhronizacija nije dostupna za domen.

IDS_TERMS_OF_SERVICE_SCREEN_SUBHEADING.en: MANAGER requires that you read and accept the following Terms of Service before using this device. These terms do not expand, modify or limit the NickelOS Terms.
IDS_TERMS_OF_SERVICE_SCREEN_SUBHEADING.t: MANAGER zahteva da pročitate i prihvatite sledeće Uslove korišćenja usluge pre korišćenja ovog uređaja. Ovi uslovi ne proširuju, menjaju niti ograničavaju Uslove za NickelOS.

IDS_UPDATE_RECOMMENDED.en: NickelOS needs to be restarted to apply the update.
IDS_UPDATE_RECOMMENDED.t: Treba da restartujete NickelOS da biste primenili ažuriranje.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TEXT.en: You’ll sign in to your device with your own account, and everyone who uses it can have one.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TEXT.t: Na uređaj se prijavljujete sopstvenim nalogom, a svako ko ga koristi može da ima svoj.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TITLE.en: Your own account on your device

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ANTIVIRUS_TEXT.en: NickelOS is designed with security in mind, and it keeps itself up to date automatically.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ANTIVIRUS_TEXT.t: NickelOS je osmišljen tako da bude bezbedan i automatski se ažurira.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_APPS_TEXT.en: NickelOS runs web apps and Linux apps side by side. Get apps for productivity, entertainment, and more.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_APPS_TEXT.t: NickelOS uporedo pokreće veb-aplikacije i Linux aplikacije. Nabavite aplikacije za produktivnost, zabavu i drugo.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_UPDATE_TEXT.en: This is the only time you’ll wait for an update. On NickelOS, software updates happen in the background.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_UPDATE_TEXT.t: Ovo je jedini trenutak kada ćete čekati na ažuriranje. U NickelOS-u se softver ažurira u pozadini.

IDS_USER_INSTALLED_CHROME_APP_DEPRECATIO.en: Chrome apps don’t run on NickelOS. Consider an alternative app.
IDS_USER_INSTALLED_CHROME_APP_DEPRECATIO.t: Chrome aplikacije ne rade na NickelOS-u. Razmislite o alternativnoj aplikaciji.

IDS_WRONG_HWID_SCREEN_MESSAGE_FIRST_PART.en: Unfortunately, your computer is configured with a malformed hardware ID. This prevents NickelOS from updating with the latest security fixes and your computer BEGIN_BOLDmay be vulnerable to malicious attacksEND_BOLD.
IDS_WRONG_HWID_SCREEN_MESSAGE_FIRST_PART.t: Nažalost, računar je konfigurisan pomoću pogrešno formatiranog ID-a hardvera. To sprečava da se NickelOS ažurira najnovijim bezbednosnim ispravkama i računar BEGIN_BOLDmože da bude podložan zlonamernim napadimaEND_BOLD.
